name: rebel-studios
description: Tools from Rebel Studios for agents that have to work real software, not demos of it.

plugins.name: thinbrowser
plugins.description: Drives a real browser for an agent and hands back 44x less page. Compact snapshots instead of whole-page accessibility dumps — measured against what Playwright's MCP server sends, and reproducible with the bundled benchmark. Clicks survive cookie bars, credentials never reach the transcript, the console and network log say what a page actually did, and a bot wall is named instead of arriving as a page with nothing on it.
